name: Uber
tagline: Global platform for rides, food and freight, now betting on robotaxis
facts: 2009, San Francisco; Travis Kalanick, Garrett Camp
CEO Dara Khosrowshahi; CFO Balaji Krishnamurthy
FY25 sales ₹3,849 cr; loss ₹1,512 cr; 225 cities

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: We reimagine the way the world moves for the better.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: The everyday app for moving people and things, and the world's largest platform for autonomous vehicles.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Cross-platform flywheel: Uber One links Mobility and Delivery, raising frequency while ads and scale lift margins.

strategy.label: AV bet
strategy.text: Aggregator of robotaxis: Waymo, Nuro/Lucid, Baidu, Pony.ai, WeRide, Wayve; $1.25B Rivian deal (Mar 2026).

strategy.label: Delivery M&A
strategy.text: Takeover offer for Delivery Hero at €41.50/share (Jul 2026); bought Getir food, Trendyol Go.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: In India, should Uber copy Rapido's driver-subscription model across cabs, even at the cost of take rate?

customers.pain: Surge pricing, cancellations, long pickups at peak
customers.why: Global reliability, safety features, consistent experience when travelling

customers.pain: Fees across rides and delivery add up
customers.why: Discounts and $0 delivery fees across Mobility and Delivery

customers.pain: Opaque fares, commission cuts, deactivation fears
customers.why: Highest demand density, instant pay; India autos keep 100% fare

customers.pain: Commissions and need for incremental orders
customers.why: Global demand, Uber Ads, marketing tools

customers.pain: Need demand and fleet operations at scale
customers.why: Uber for Business, Freight, and demand aggregation for AV fleets

products.name: UberX / Go / Premier
products.desc: Core car rides across price tiers

products.name: Moto and Auto
products.desc: Bike taxis and autorickshaws, key in India

products.name: Autonomous rides
products.desc: Robotaxi trips via Waymo, WeRide, Baidu and others

portfolio.north_star: Completed trips per MAPC per month
portfolio.key_metrics: Trips, gross bookings, take rate, ETA, driver supply hours
portfolio.guardrails: Safety incidents, cancellation rate, driver earnings per hour

products.name: Uber Eats
products.desc: Restaurant delivery in global markets (exited India 2020)

products.name: Uber Ads
products.desc: Sponsored listings for merchants and CPG brands

portfolio.north_star: Weekly delivery orders per active eater
portfolio.key_metrics: Delivery GB growth (+25% cc), basket size, ad revenue, segment margin
portfolio.guardrails: Order accuracy, courier earnings, merchant churn

products.name: Uber One
products.desc: Cross-product membership for discounts and free delivery

products.name: Uber for Business
products.desc: Corporate rides and meals with central billing

products.name: Uber Freight
products.desc: Digital freight brokerage and logistics software

portfolio.north_star: Share of gross bookings from cross-platform members

rows.how: Service fee ~30% of fare; India autos via driver subscription
Merchant commission plus consumer delivery and service fees
Sponsored listings, in-app and in-car ads

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Q2 2026 revenue: Mobility $7.4B, Delivery $5.2B, Freight $1.6B; Delivery fastest growing at +28%.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 208M consumers pay; drivers and merchants are suppliers but also pay fees or subscriptions.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Adj EBITDA 4.9% of gross bookings; Mobility segment profit $2.2B, Delivery $1.1B in Q2 2026.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Uber One, ads, AV partnerships, Delivery Hero scale, low-cost products like Moto in emerging markets.

bullets.label: India
bullets.text: India FY25 loss ₹1,512 cr; Uber infused ₹2,921 cr (Feb 2026) to fight Rapido, now named top rival.

friction: Surge pricing feels unpredictable and unfair
Driver cancellations after accepting rides, India especially
AC, cash and destination disputes with drivers
Advance tip prompts seen as dark patterns

competitors.label: US / global rides
competitors.text: Lyft, Waymo One, Tesla robotaxi, Bolt, Didi, Grab

competitors.label: Delivery
competitors.text: DoorDash, Instacart, Just Eat Takeaway, Amazon

competitors.label: India
competitors.text: Rapido (largest by rides), Ola, Namma Yatri, Bharat Taxi, inDrive

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Global scale, cross-platform membership, AV demand aggregation, $10B+ FCF

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: AV players going direct, gig regulation, India losses, Delivery Hero integration

news.label: Sep 2026
news.text: Issued €4.5B euro bonds to help fund Delivery Hero takeover.

news.label: Aug 2026
news.text: Q2 bookings $58B (+22% cc); India hits 225 cities; Rapido merger talks reportedly failed.

news.label: Jul 2026
news.text: Agreed €41.50/share takeover offer for Delivery Hero; closed Getir food acquisition.

news.label: Watch
news.text: Delivery Hero regulatory approvals (H2 2027) and whether India moves to subscription cabs.

sources: Uber Q2 2026 earnings release and 10-Q (SEC), 8-K filings, Uber India RoC filings via press, Wikipedia. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
